messages:
sanjay: quick perf probe — saw repeated p95 spikes when microbatch_interval=1ms and coalesce_delay=0.5ms, jitter=0.

maria: logs? profiler output?

sanjay: dumping shorttrace + sampler: kernel selection flips on ~10% of batches; KV hit rate drops ~7% in the flakier windows. attach gist with flame and timeline.

kai: interesting. if jitter=0, arrivals align -> microbursts. jitter reduces synchrony but increases variance in batch shapes which can trigger kernel thrash.

anya: also noticed KV priming suffers when tiny windows eject early requests before KV warmups finish. that explains the hit-rate dip.

sanjay: here's a quick config I tried locally:
```
microbatch_interval_ms: 1
coalesce_delay_ms: 0.8
coalesce_jitter_ms: exponential(0.2)
target_tokens_per_batch: 12
shape_smoothing_alpha: 0.3
kv_priming_window_ms: 8
```
result: p95 down ~8% overall, p50 unchanged, KV_hit +3pt, kernel_switch_rate reduced vs uniform jitter.

maria: can you run ablation: (1) no jitter, (2) uniform jitter 0-1ms, (3) exp jitter above? small sample 1M req each.

sanjay: running now — preliminary: (1) baseline p95 420ms, (2) uniform p95 385ms, (3) exp p95 360ms. kernel switch rate: baseline 14%, uniform 9%, exp 6%.

kai: exponential works because it de-synchronizes heavy tails more often while leaving short waits for most requests. smart. also good to add EMA on batch shape to avoid flip-flopping kernel picks.

anya: rollout proposal: canary 1% traffic for 24h with metrics: p50/p95/p99, kv_hit_rate, kernel_switch_rate, tokens_per_request, cost_per_token. auto rollback if p99 increases >5% or kernel_switch_rate spike >2x.

sanjay: agree. add failover policy to pin to fallback kernel when kernel_switch_rate > threshold for 5m. also reduce target_tokens_per_batch to 8 for latency-sensitive routes.

maria: don't forget to track regen rate of KV priming (primed_keys/sec). we saw microbursts increase churn.

perf-bot: scheduled canary deploy to infra-canary-3 at 2026-03-18T02:00Z. alert rules copied: infra/perf/microbatch-canary.

kai: one more edge: model-quantized kernels sometimes have worse throughput for small shapes. add per-model min_batch_size guard to avoid regressions.

sanjay: noted — I'll open a tiny PR with the config + canary playbook and include rollback hooks + dashboards to monitor kernel_heatmap, kv_priming, and cost. tagging @maria @kai for review.

maria: SGTM, please include the microtrace snippet and metrics dashboard links in the PR. :thumbsup:
